notes: Shopify store, reached directly via Chrome (robots.txt allows all agents incl. Claude, names UCP/MCP endpoints, no disallow). Tree built from the header mega-menu (chair-stools, shoe-cabinet, other-furniture, storage links) plus a full /collections.json sweep (270 collections) and the sitemap_collections XML, cross-checked against a sitewide product_type='Furniture' sweep (26 of 762 products site-wide, via /collections/all/products.json paginated) to confirm completeness. The site's own top furniture node is 'Modern Furniture' (/collections/furniture, 23 products) which has three genuine chip-filtered children on its own page: Chair & Stools (5), Shoe Cabinet (8), Other Furniture (9) -- reported as a grouping row + 3 leaves per the URL hierarchy rule. One product in the parent listing (The Flora Chair) is not tagged into any of the 3 chips (23 vs 22 union) -- a real, minor site-side tagging gap; not fabricated into any qty. 'Accent Furniture' (/collections/accent-furniture, 3 products, all side tables, product_type=Furniture) is a separate, genuine, sitemap-indexed collection not currently linked from the Modern Furniture page or main nav, but confirmed real via the sitewide Furniture-type sweep (23+3=26, matching exactly) -- reported as its own leaf. All 4 leaf qtys corroborated two ways: rendered listing header ('N products') matched exactly against /collections/<handle>/products.json array-length enumeration for every leaf. Excluded: 'Storage' collection (6 products: ModuBox, StorraDeck x2, Totem Tower, storage basket, Origami Box -- standalone storage goods, not furniture, per rule). 'Stools & Leg-Rests' (3 pouffes) -- looked like furniture by name but the site itself tags all 3 as product_type='Home Furnishing' with tags incl. 'Homedecoritems', not Furniture; excluded on the site's own classification. 'Soft Furniture' collection -- 0 products, ambiguous naming (soft furnishings, not furniture), not linked in current nav; skipped rather than guessed. 'Dining' and 'Dining Set Collections' collections are entirely tableware/dinnerware (plates, cups, mugs) despite the name -- out of scope, this is a furniture-only task. Three '<theme>-dining-collection' marketing pages (Azure Ixora, Surreal Majestic Earth, Tropical Trip) are empty (0 products) themed bundles, not real categories -- skipped. No Sofas/Beds/Wardrobes/Dining Tables/Bookcases/TV Units categories exist anywhere on the site (confirmed via collections.json keyword sweep + sitewide product_type sweep) -- The Artment is primarily a wall-art/home-decor brand with a small 'space-saving furniture' side-line limited to seating, shoe cabinets, and small cabinets/side tables.
